same_controls_similarity_diagnostic.policy: Algebraic diagnostic only. Full original control set, no deletions or coordinate changes. Not a fresh result or adopted replacement.

trial_policy: Diagnostic only. No trial is adopted, no checks removed, no bias correction applied. Prior checks are known and cannot supply fresh validation.
baseline_role_now: Known diagnostic checks; original first-round validation status preserved in baseline record

review_scope.context: Complete scan/reference context and all control/check locations inspected
review_scope.native_details: Four largest-error known checks (all when fewer than four) and two largest fitting-residual controls; additional focused pairs where ambiguity required
review_scope.not_claimed: Exhaustive second native audit of every point, fresh validation on unchanged sheets, measured historical accuracy floor, or geographic/user acceptance

source_uncertainty_policy: Original per-point uncertainty retained, never subtracted from errors. Generalized geometry is a possible explanation, not a measured floor or proof of historical change.
decision: retain baseline failure; no accepted replacement
visual_findings: Maccan southern tributaries are ordered similarly, but Stephen Mills Q03 lies in a generalized reach whose modern channel and forks differ materially. Little Forks uses branch split with centreline/bank ambiguity. Q03 is 445.6 m while other checks are much smaller, insufficient evidence for global warp; investigate broad topology before accepting any identity correction. Broad Maccan context traced the principal Leamington/Mapleton fork and successive westward southern tributaries. The disputed Stephen Mills tributary is in the expected order but with strongly differing spacings. No secure alternative branch identity was established; retain the failure and uncertainty.
baseline_limitations: First independent RMS 235.59 m exceeds the 100 m ceiling. Median 103.89 m, P95 396.35 m and maximum 445.64 m also exceed companion criteria. The failed first fit and all checks remain unchanged.
Only three stream-junction control regions support the constrained similarity. Four checks share those river systems, including one particularly close to a control.
Northern edge, far west and eastern and southern corners have no independent validation. Entire imagery is retained without geographic acceptance.
Generalized single-line historical rivers differ from modern bank and centreline representations; working source uncertainty is 18 px.
control_findings: Central west-tributary junction and Little Forks northern tributary can be traced through their neighbouring branches. Bank/centreline representation differs.
decision_basis: No evidenced point correction or independently supported replacement established. Keep original fit, every original diagnostic check, source mask and inset placement. Lower residual under a trial alone is insufficient.
